answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization aims at condensing a text into a shorter version while maintaining the essential information.

answer_2.quote: we measure the recall-oriented ROUGE-1 scores between system and reference headlines.

answer_4.quote: we asked a human subject to judge the truthfulness of the headlines generated by the baseline setting and filtering+pseudo strategy.
answer_4.guideline: Presented with both a source document and a headline generated by the model, the human subject judged whether the headline was truthful, untruthful, or incomprehensible.
